comments.content: `get_doc_ids_by_doc_names()` returns `None` when `doc_names` is empty or has no matches. Requests that specify only `doc_ids` will therefore fail at `if doc_id not in doc_ids`, and an unmatched name will also break `get_by_ids`. Make the bulk helper always return a list (use `[]` for no matches).

This changes the singular helper's semantics from at most one document per requested name to every document with that name, without any tenant or knowledge-base restriction. Since document names are not globally unique, removing by name can now include additional documents, potentially from other tenants. Pass the authenticated tenant/KB scope into this query and explicitly handle duplicate names rather than returning every global match.
